description: handle_email_copy at line 2037-2039 uses args.get('create').and_then(|v| v.as_object()).map(|m| m.clone()) to get the create map, allocating a full Map clone. The loop at line 2074 then iterates by borrow (&create), forcing copy_id.clone() on every arm (6+ sites including not_created inserts and the copied_source_ids push). Since args: Value is owned, args.remove('create') would yield an owned Map without the initial clone, and iterating by move would eliminate all per-iteration copy_id clones. The same pattern fixed in JMAP-4ii.68/70/71 applies here.
title: email_copy: args.get('create').clone() should be args.remove('create')
